title: dryopteris flaccida
intro: Dryopteris flaccida, commonly known as the weak-stemmed wood fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Dryopteris flaccida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
